entries.claim: Evan Henry is a 6'3", 310lb offensive tackle from D'oto, Texas.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry was a three-star prospect and ranked 131st in Texas for his position coming out of high school.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry has three years of eligibility remaining.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry lost 20 pounds towards the end of the 2020 season.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry started the last seven of the ten games he played in during the 2020 season at right guard.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry led ULM's offensive line in total plays (565) and pancakes (16) in the 2020 season, despite not starting the first three games.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry allowed only 1.5 sacks in 350 passing plays during the 2020 season.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: Evan Henry's best performance in 2020 was against Texas State, where he won 88% of his matchups and had a season-high four pancakes.
entries.source_name: The BlitzCity Podcast

entries.claim: The speaker believes Evan Henry will be in the starting five for South Carolina State in the fall.

entries.claim: The speaker believes Evan Henry is the big piece South Carolina State needed on their offensive line.
